Our resident lewdtuber Vex was there to offer comfort and perspective: "Man, I HATE when a sudden loss of power delays my full release! That's why I always keep spare batteries in my bedside drawer."

notes.title: May 30 Dev Campfire Stream Recording
notes.content:
If you missed our May 30th Developer Campfire, not to worry! We recorded the entire session for you to watch at your own schedule.  And if you're more of a reader, or just want to scan for your answers, we've got a transcript for you below.

[previewyoutube=NYl_3Snq_A4;full][/previewyoutube]


[b]Do you have plans to update older dreams in graphics/gameplay?[/b]

We are currently making it our focus to give all of the dreams a refresh. Our first dreams will be experiencing complete graphical, storyline, and gameplay reworks. Even our newer ones will be receiving some updates that we know the community will love. This has all been based off of player and community feedback, and we’re excited to show you what we’re up to in an upcoming announcement.


 [b]Will you offer DLC bundles?[/b]

Yes. We have been looking through all of the reviews for Playspace, and we’ve been creating new pricing structures and bundles based on the feedback that we’ve been receiving. We acknowledge that the freemium model needs to be changed, and we will be doing that in a way that’s fair for existing players as well as newcomers to Playspace.


[b]What are your plans with Vex Ruby stream implementation with Playspace?[/b]

One of our biggest passions as a studio is to provide a live VR stream experience, not just for Vex but for all streamers. We are currently working on a brand new Novellus Dea dream experience, and we will be working on VR stream implementation after its release.


[b]Do you have any non-VR plans?[/b]

Other than private spaces, all experience in ViRo Playspace can be experienced without a VR headset and is well optimized for devices like the Valve Steam Deck. Part of our dream overhaul we mentioned earlier is to better optimize all of our experiences for non-VR use, though we recommend and encourage all of our Dreams to be played in VR.


[b]Are there plans for character customization?[/b]

Currently, we are working on Playspace in phases. We plan to finish touching up and updating our existing Dreams first and foremost. Our studio also has several Dreams in production at the moment as well. Once we are finished improving the current game sense and experience, we will be evaluating the best way to move forward with character customization.


[b]What will it take for the game to be out of early access?[/b]

We are working on the roadmap out of early access as we speak, and plan on sharing our steps with the community. We want to make sure to create a game that the community and the studio is proud of. We are creating a rubric of key criteria for the project as a whole. This includes bringing existing dreams up to par, refreshing UX/UI experience, and making networked features like private spaces accessible to everyone.


[b]Are there going to be more dreams from different perspectives?[/b]

We have heard the feedback, and we would love to implement a voyeur mode in Playspace to allow you to view the scene from different perspectives


[b]Do you plan to work with more content creators?[/b]

Yes! Our goal is to support content creators with the tools needed and provide opportunities for them as well. We have already added to the list of content creators we are crafting new Dreams with, and will be putting out information in the near future as to how to work with us. If you know any content creators who would be interested in working with our products, please invite them to our Discord!


[b]Any more original dreams not from content creators?[/b]

Also yes! We have several original Dreams in pre-production right now. We are also proud to announce that we have new in house voice actors and actresses on the team as well to add variety to the current and upcoming experiences.


[b]Any social aspect plans for the game?[/b]

We absolutely do have plans for social aspects for Playspace, and we recognize that this feature is one that is highly anticipated by our community. One of the things that is important for us to get right with no exceptions is the privacy of our users. We want our games to be a safe space that adults can explore their sexuality without the worry of privacy. Part of our roadmap for exiting Early Access is to expand our networking features to be available to everyone. Once this is complete, we will be working on bringing the social aspect of Playspace to life.


[b]Do you have plans for content outside of Dreams in Playspace?[/b]

Yes. One of our ultimate goals is to make content creation available to anyone who uses the Playspace platform. Think of the Dreams as lewd Pixar-like cinematic experiences. It would be exciting to see experiences created by the community, for the community. Additionally, we’d like to expand on our ASMVR. Any feedback you may have on our ASMVR experiences would be invaluable to us.


[b]Where'd you get inspiration for the lobby area vibes/design?[/b]

We wanted a futuristic, fun approach that felt familiar to the adult space. We took a lot of inspiration from adult websites and, believe it or not, Tron!


[b]Will there be the possibility of more freedom within dreams?[/b]

Yes, we are currently producing brand new Dreams where the player has more freedom to interact. And, interestingly,  we’ve created the blueprints  for multiplayer dreams! (ie, one in a swing, and one able to interact/walk at any angle)


[b]Do you have plans to include more diverse sexual niches/kinks?[/b]

Sexual exploration and kink experiences are some of the main pillars of our studio. The dreams we are producing right now (and the ones we are revamping) will cover more kinks and sexual preferences. We now have a question for you. What would you as a community like to see more of in our Dream offerings?


[b]What can I do to run the game on lower end systems/are there going to be any graphics options available in the future?[/b]

We purposely build ViRo Playspace on computers that are over 10 years old, specifically to accommodate as many systems as possible. Part of that is making sure we maintain the minimum specifications for VR capability. That being said, we are going to be offering more in game options to tailor the experience more to your needs in the future.


[b]What toys are available for use in the game?[/b]

We are incredibly excited to announce that we will soon be able to support over 300 toys and devices using qDot’s Intiface application. It’s a slightly different process than we use now to connect to Playspace, but it will allow for more toy support than ever before and you won’t have to wait for us to push an update to have access to more toys.



[h3]Questions From The Discord Thread[/h3]

[b]Remind me what is Viro's end goal?
[/b]
Our goal is to enable people to explore and discover aspects of sexuality with themselves and others in a safe, non judgemental environment. With the freedom of an avatar, you’re able to challenge what you believed to be normal, experience new or unfamiliar territory, and find yourself in the process. We not only have the means to embody an avatar but also, now with the advances in technology, the sensations of sound/sight/touch that can be taken to whole new levels. Through this, we are able to find new people and ideas that promote sexual positivity.

[b]What are you hoping to have completed within five years?[/b]

With our plans in motion, we are striving for total studio sustainability, a bustling community of like minded explorers and creators, the industry standard in creator tools in the intimate space, a vast educational network for creators who are interested in entering this space, and the ability to make lewdtubing available to everyone with a very low bar of entry.

[b]How do you all feel about what progression has been made so far with everything Viro related?
[/b]
We are extremely optimistic about the trajectory that we are on now. We have a newly expanded team, a more pointed vision now more than ever, and the best tools in the industry. We have accomplished everything we have so far without having to answer to investors who will dictate the future of our studio. We have the means to keep the lights on and work on everything internally, even with our small team. While we acknowledge that our progress has been slow up until this point, we are more ready that we have ever been to skyrocket toward the future we all see for ViRo.

[b]Is there anything as the community that we can do to help you guys move forward or help ease your minds?[/b]

There are plenty of things that can be done to help us move forward and ease our minds, and you made the very first step by asking questions for our campfire! 
[list]
[*] Get the word out about our games and apps.
[*] Retweet/share our updates on social media and in your other social spaces.
[*] Support the Patreon if you are able to contribute monetarily.
[*] Invite like minded people to the Discord, even just to be part of the community.
[*] Attend our monthly Campfires and ask questions
[*] Leave reviews on our pages and apps (positive, we hope!)
[/list]
	
[b]Lol when can I start sending gifts to you all and buy things for you all. (Like the throne site or amazon with private address set up). I'm sure I'm not the only one who has some things I want to send you all =p [/b]

This is tricky because we have team members all over the US who contribute to what we do. Perhaps we can create a company Throne and you can buy specific people on the team gifts if you choose. What do you think of that idea?


[b]How did the whole team come together? Like was it a fully fledged studio job from the start, or did things start as more individual projects and things grew over time? Is any of the team surprised to find themselves in this specific field now they are here, or has it always felt like that perfect fit?[/b]

It’s a bit of both. Like minded individuals, and those minds happened to be in the gutter. Rave decided to go indie after spending about 10 yrs at a triple A game studio. He and CoderDev have been working together ever since. In 2019,  we decided to focus on sex positivity content, and we are fortunate to have the absolute best  mocap system that can capture intricate body movements and body language. We have a passion to show that sexuality isn’t just raunchy or negative, it can be silly, positive, dorky and funny. As time went along, people joined the team, including an amazing person in marketing who just joined.


[b]I forget you talked about the video work is it going to be something like VRChat and have many locations in it? Anything in these locations going to be interactable with?[/b]

We’re starting small in private spaces/rooms, where our primary focus is on sound and touch, and expanding from there.


[b]Can we bring our own avatars somehow?[/b]

That is our ultimate goal - to support avatar formats similar to LewdTube Studio.


[b] Is there any plan for a group social area in VR, or is it just going to be private rooms?[/b]

We are starting with private rooms to get a firm understanding on what’s needed for larger networking. Maintaining user privacy is our top priority, so we’re starting small with the building blocks and going from there.


[b] Is there any plan for more gay male content?[/b]

Yes, this is absolutely something we’re going to do. What gay male content in particular would you like to see?


[b]What has been your trickiest thing to bring to light, and or to create concerning ViRo?[/b]

Finding a web designer who understands our very particular need for the NSFW space as well as networking privacy as we discussed earlier in terms of social spaces.


[b]Was there ever a plan to start programs like Lewdtube Studio or did that develop from the love of the studio work?[/b]

It came from our utter shock that to become a lewdtuber, you have to go through a cobbled mess of applications including Unity (which was not made with the lewdtuber in mind). So when we developed the Vex Ruby technology and fine tuned it, there was a point where we were like “we should just make this available to everyone”. Much like our plans for social features for adults, LTS is specifically for lewdtubers. We’re not pushing other platforms beyond their TOS, this *IS* for them.

notes.title: Buttplug Update in Public Beta
notes.content:
Hey everybody!

We’ve just released an update to the public beta we believe will eliminate a lot (if not all) of the connection headache that some of you have been experiencing. If you’ve been having trouble connecting your toy to ViRo Playspace, please do give it a try and let us know how it works for you.

[h3]A little history[/h3]
In the early days of ViRo Playspace, qdot was kind enough to help us develop a specialized version of Buttplug built directly into ViRo. (We called it, predictably, the Buttplugin.) We wanted to make the experience as seamless as possible for our users, and as such, didn’t want anyone to have to download something separate if we could help it.

[h3]The times are a-changin’[/h3]
It was a great solution back then, but as is often the case, environments change, and solutions must adapt. We started getting complaints about toys having difficulty connecting - Kiiroo users in particular seemed to bear the brunt of these frustrations. We assumed it was the same connectivity issues that we’d dealt with in the studio from time to time, and offered the solutions that usually fixed things for us. And it worked for some of you. But for others, the problem persisted.

[h3]Aha![/h3]
When you told us your toys were having no problems connecting to Intiface Central? [b]That was our lightbulb moment.[/b] We did some digging, and it became clear. Now that Intiface Central has grown into the expected standard for haptic toy connection - meaning most Buttplug users have it installed already - our built-in Buttplug was now [i]creating[/i] rather than eliminating confusion.

A Buttplug traffic jam, if you will.

So, if you've been one of the ones having difficulty connecting your toys, thank you for your patience and feedback as we've  worked through this issue, and let us know how the update works for you. And even if your toy has been connecting just fine, we'd still love your feedback!

notes.title: It's been a while. Let me explain.
notes.content:
[h2]Greetings![/h2]

As one of the developers of ViRo Playspace, I wanted to take a moment to explain why we've been quiet from posting development updates. 

[h2]Keeping the Lights On[/h2]
Being a small indie studio has many challenges and one of them is trying to find the right path to keep the studio functional.

As you may recall, we released [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1845830/ViRo_Live_Studio/]ViRo Live Studio[/url] a while back. This was an app that took everything we learned about motion capture and live streaming (from [url=https://viro.club/vexruby]Vex Ruby[/url]) and made it available on Steam for anyone to use.

The initial goal was to build a tool so people could create their own experiences like you see on ViRo Playspace.  Some of this motion tech made it into our [url=https://www.patreon.com/posts/online-private-70768465]private spaces[/url] (private rooms in ViRo Playspace), but ultimately we didn’t have a path to give us the financial runway to stay alive.

We then got a tip that Meta's Oculus division was looking for content creators to pitch ideas.  Meta would provide some small funding in hopes that a studio would create a runaway hit.  We made a pitch for a VTuber app for Meta Quest - just like ViRo Live Studio, but exclusively on Meta Quest and without the need for a PC.

This took months to create a prototype for Meta, but we ultimately got turned down.  They told us it was too complicated to use.

[b][i]They were right.[/i][/b]

Hurt from our lost time in development, we were again tipped off to reach out to Oculus, but this time to a different department. They were looking for content that showcased mixed reality features.

We knew it would be a hard sell to re-pitch the same project, so we reached out to our friends at another VR studio.

Together, we refined the pitch to Oculus - this time under our friends’ studio name to help with credibility since we are not in a position to showcase our previous work due to the adult nature of the content.  The pitch was approved.

[h2]Crunch Time[/h2]
From early spring to mere days ago, we crunched to make the best VTubing app we could. It had to be easy enough for anyone to use without losing any advanced features.  The funding was barely enough to ensure we didn’t close down during development.  While it didn’t help with runway, it did gave us a chance to build new tools for our plans moving forward with ViRo.

I'm happy to report that this title has finally been released, and we are now able to put focus squarely back on ViRo development.

[h2]What about ViRo Playspace?[/h2]
While the world of ViRo has been quiet on the surface, it is still very much alive.  The entire team here is very passionate about bringing true openness to sexuality in a safe way that enables people to discover, explore, and connect.

We're taking everything we developed and adding it to our bag of tools.  We've also significantly upgraded or motion capture capabilities during this time.  This will help us produce better content moving forward.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35735466/cc4411ce07525830490cf4d1f01bc276984ed730.png[/img]


[h2]What about the next ViRo Dream?[/h2]
We've also started production on the next ViRo Playspace Dream release

We’re happy to report that [url=https://store.steampowered.com/agecheck/app/2236690/]Novellus Dea[/url] really enjoyed her previous experience with us and has signed on for another go.

[b]It's called [u]Unsealed Love[/u][/b]


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35735466/0c368281bfd25d06181797ced13700855488e444.jpg[/img]


Production is going to be a little different with this one. With previous Dreams, we played our cards a little closer to our chest during development, because we love to deliver big surprises. 

[b]I won’t be doing that this time.[/b]

Instead, expect live developer streams, sneak peeks, videos, and other tidbits. I'll be posting updates on Patreon and streaming on our Discord.  I’m a night owl, and often am working while Vex and the team are asleep, so having you folks around keeps me going.

Our first event is scheduled to be on Wednesday, November 22nd in the evening.  We'll be live streaming our motion capture session for the upcoming dream.  I'll post more details in a separate Patreon post when available.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35735466/8513a7348f0961ba517ecc75c4c2d6008cfd637e.png[/img]

A shoutout here to Vex Ruby, who has been tirelessly keeping ViRo alive with her streams during crunch, all while balancing her own educational and professional goals. Her streams serve as the testing ground for potential ViRo features, and her good humor (along with her knack for pushing features to the limits of their capability, whether she knows it or not) keeps us on our toes. Moreover, she's been the mocap star for most of our Dreams. We all feel lucky to have her with us.

Finally, I want to offer heartfelt thanks on behalf of all of us here at ViRo for all your support and encouragement.  I cannot emphasize enough:

[b]You’ve truly kept us going.  We wouldn't be here without you.[/b]

From the bottom of our weird, pervy hearts, thank you.

notes.title: Massive ViRo Playspace Update
notes.content:
We have some big announcements!

We are excited to announce that our latest Dream experience titled “Ela’s Dreamscape” will be available for purchase here on Steam in one week!

Additionally, we are officially releasing our new and improved build of ViRo Playspace on Steam today and we’re making it easier than ever to access ViRo Dream Experiences. All the Dream Experiences have been updated and repackaged as Steam DLC because a lot of people were having trouble getting them using Steam's microtransaction overlay.  

We’ve done a massive overhaul and improved all of the Dream Experiences, so the ones you already own should have a pretty nice makeover. They won’t show up as DLC that you own on Steam yet, but they will still be available in your account. 

Going forward, we are ending support for the standalone version of ViRo Playspace and moving it exclusively to the Steam platform. This move will give us more bandwidth to focus on content creation and develop the various social features for the platform. Part of our migration to Steam is stepping away from in-game currency. Our token system was originally implemented for online features that are still in development, and we believe that switching to simple DLC items instead of in-game currency will make more sense and be easier for everyone.

We will happily help you migrate any purchased tokens still on your account to DLC content.  Just fill out the form on [url=http://viro.club/tokens]this page[/url] and we’ll take care of it. It’s a manual process on our end so it may take a day or two.

Finally, if you’ve only ever used our Standalone app and are new to using ViRo Playspace on Steam, fear not! All of the content you own is still accessible on your account can easily be transferred over by linking your account to the Steam version of the app which you can do as soon as you launch it.

notes.title: Upcoming App Improvements!
notes.content:
We have a lot of new developments on the way for ViRo Playspace! The finishing touches are being added to the Ela Darling dream experience, we have an exciting new ASMR project in the works, and we’re doing an overhaul to the backend of the whole application.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35735466/fce12ecf08fb253fbed757015fc599a6eb6d6abc.png[/img]

We’re in the process of updating Unity, the game engine behind ViRo Playspace, as well as qdot's plugin that fuels our haptics integration. 

Here are a few of the improvements you can expect over the next couple updates:
[list]
[*] Stability, crashes, and performance- a handful of people have experienced an issue where the app crashes on launch. We believe that the Unity engine update will help resolve some of these issues.
[*] Rendering pipeline- the experiences you already know and love will be touched up a bit with better lighting, shadows, visual effects, and more.
[*] Animation- we will be able to use better tools to create and cleanup animation which means you’ll see higher quality movement and we will be able to speed up the development process on new releases, to get them to you faster without sacrificing quality
[*] Haptics- we will be able to support even more haptics devices and offer more functionality for your favorite toys. We are planning to implement some in-app tools to allow more control over haptic ranges and a lab where you can more easily and thoroughly setup and test your devices.
[/list]

Additionally, some of you may have noticed that we transitioned away from the limited rentals, and instead will cycle through the Dreams so one is always free to try.

Ultimately, these updates will make your ViRo Playspace experience smoother, easier, and a whole lot sexier.
